new_learnings.text: Breadth quality asymmetry: 110涨停 vs 18跌停 with 871 stocks up >4% vs 213 down >4% means the upside is concentrated and powerful. The headline Up/Down ratio of 1.05:1 understates bullish participation quality. The V2 1.5:1 gate may be too blunt in this regime but strict adherence is the discipline.
new_learnings.mechanism: When indices are green and 涨停>>跌停, breadth ratio alone may miss the quality of upside. Consider adding a secondary gate: r10 > 3× f10 + indices all green = allow despite sub-1.5:1 breadth.

new_learnings.text: Both held positions (上海新阳 +36.8%, 路维光电 +30.4%) have 0 risk factors from cheesefortune scanner. Zero-risk + hot sector + strong catalyst is the winning formula. Prioritize 0-risk candidates in future entry decisions.
new_learnings.mechanism: 0 risk factors means no flagged concerns about debt, cash flow, governance, or valuation traps — the structural integrity supports the momentum thesis and reduces downside during pullbacks.

new_learnings.text: Today 15+ strategy pool stocks fail Rule 2b (MA distance). In a hot tape, the majority of strong names are already extended. The MA anti-chase rule is protecting us from buying at euphoric prices. Confirms h027.
new_learnings.mechanism: Hot sectors attract chasers who push stocks far above support. MA-distance discipline forces patience — the pullback to MA5/MA10 is statistically likely within 3-5 days.

new_learnings.text: Volume confirmation on existing winners: 上海新阳 7.2× mavol30 and 路维光电 15.5× mavol30 with flat/minor price action = institutional accumulation, not distribution. High volume without price decline on winners is a strong HOLD signal.
new_learnings.mechanism: When a stock trades 7-15× normal volume without price decline, institutions are building positions quietly. This is accumulation, not distribution. It argues against premature profit-taking.
